title: House of Peace-8 miles from Downtown with Jacuzzi
description:
Forget your worries in this spacious and serene space.

The space
Welcome to our cozy retreat, conveniently located just minutes away from the vibrant heart of Nashville and in front of Kid Rock's house! 
Our beautiful house features 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, comfortably accommodating 10 guests with 1 king, 2 queen, 3 full beds and a futon. The open-concept living area is thoughtfully decorated creating a warm and peaceful atmosphere.
Not only is there a fully equipped kitchen but for added entertainment, our home features a fantastic game room. Challenge your friends to a friendly game of pool or show off your skills at the ping pong table. 

Step outside onto the private patio, where you'll find your very own Jacuzzi - the perfect place to relax and soak your cares away after a day of exploring downtown Nashville. The patio also offers outdoor seating and a BBQ grill, ideal for hosting and enjoying Nashville's pleasant weather.

Location:
Our home is ideally situated just a short drive from downtown Nashville(8mi), offering easy access to the city's renowned music venues, excellent restaurants, and trendy shops. You'll have the best of both worlds - a peaceful retreat to unwind after a day of exploration, yet close enough to enjoy all the excitement that Nashville has to offer. 

Whether you're visiting Nashville for business or pleasure, our charming retreat offers everything you need for an unforgettable stay. We look forward to hosting you and ensuring you have a wonderful time in the House of Peace!
